tests.name: Content: 62 unique weapons, 28 relics, 8 synergies, 13 attack behaviors
Seeded maps: 1,500 floors, unique cells, connected graph, guaranteed special rooms
Interior navigation: 450 generated layouts preserve a connected walkable field
Movement and rays: dash cannot tunnel through a thin prop; room bounds clip rays
Loot: deterministic pools; graduation weapon stays locked until a win
Synergies require two separate tags; stat ceilings and +3 upgrade ceiling
Pause freezes all gameplay clocks and player coordinates
Focus recovery, drinking, dash immunity, and per-slot fire cooldowns
All 62 weapons create real damage with their actual engine behavior
Beam and very fast projectiles hit front targets but not through cover
Water/electric interaction applies 35% bonus; boss stun has a short cap
Visual settings do not alter combat RNG or critical damage
Treasure pickup is transactional and cannot be claimed twice
Shops do not charge for full-health healing; sold items and upgrade cap persist
All eight event branches execute; costs and HP payments stay valid
Room-boundary save rolls an unfinished battle back; cleared rooms do not respawn
Meta upgrades are snapshotted per run, not retroactively added to an old checkpoint
Malformed metadata is sanitized; malformed checkpoints fail safely
Each boss executes all three phases without non-finite entities
Summon and particle limits hold in a 90-second stress simulation
Complete seeded campaigns: doors, 3 bosses, portals, final cinematic, once-only rewards
Death, one-time revive, and capped permanent upgrades are consistent
